workarounds.symptom: test(ai): two Cursor tests race a wall clock and fail on an oversubscribed host
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(ai): Cursor retries ignore a closed attempt's late stream events; take the OAuth and checkpoint-resume tests off the wall clock. Target files: packages/ai/src/api/cursor-agent.ts, packages/ai/test/cursor-agent-exec-lifecycle-harness.ts, packages/ai/test/cursor-oauth.test.ts. Two Cursor tests in `packages/ai` depended on how fast the host ran and failed on busy machines. Both now run without the wall clock. Making one of them deterministic also exposed a retry race in `cursor-agent.ts`, which is fixed here. (Ref: https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/7420)
